title: Reconcile doc hygiene and compatibility warnings
summary: Fix or explicitly cover remaining related-doc, large-doc, and compatibility export warning classes after priority ownership/gate tasks.

goal.outcome: Low-risk doc hygiene and compatibility export warning classes are fixed or explicitly covered after priority ownership/gate tasks are in place.
acceptance: Missing Related docs sections are added where required or linter policy is adjusted with evidence.
Large-doc warnings are reduced by split/cut or accepted as covered residuals with trigger.
Compatibility export gaps are resolved by map/policy cleanup or deferred with explicit owner and trigger.
non_goals: Do not perform broad lexicon rewrite unrelated to warning classes.
Do not change source compatibility exports unless a specific warning requires it.
